capabilities: Sync Voicenotes data into notes automatically at a set frequency
Render AI summaries, actions, and TODOs as note sections with optional tags
Download the audio file referenced by each transcript
Customize note and frontmatter templates with Jinja-style variables
Optionally delete synced notes from the Voicenotes server
extras: The README notes the delete-from-server mode is destructive and requires double opt-in toggles; the project was transferred from its original author to the official Voicenotes team.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull voice recordings, transcripts, and AI-generated content from a Voicenotes account into vault notes.

relations.evidence: sync down your thoughts and ideas from Voicenotes web & mobile apps

summary: Syncs recordings, transcripts, AI summaries, and TODOs from Voicenotes.com into Obsidian notes on a configurable schedule.
